#include <string>

int main()
{
    std::string s;
    std::cin >> s;

    s.replace(s.find("at", 1), 2, "@");

    for (std::string::size_type pos = s.find("dot", 1);
         pos != std::string::npos && pos <= s.size() - 4;
         pos = s.find("dot", 1))

    }

    std::cout << s;
    return 0;

#include <iostream>
#include <string>

void replace_dots(std::string &s)
{
    while (true)
    {
        std::string::size_type p = s.find("dot", 1);
        if (p == std::string::npos || p > s.length() - 4)
            return;
        s.replace(p, 3, ".");
    }
}

int main()
{
    std::string s;
    std::cin >> s;

    s.replace(s.find("at", 1), 2, "@");
    replace_dots(s);

    std::cout << s;
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

int main()
{
    std::string s;
    std::cin >> s;

    s.replace(s.find("at", 1), 2, "@");

    std::string::size_type p;
    while ((p = s.find("dot", 1)) != std::string::npos)
    {
        if (p > s.length() - 4)
            break;
        s = s.substr(0, p) + "." + s.substr(p + 3);
    }

    std::cout << s;
    return 0;
}
